P4.title: Explaining cover accurately: team TL-4
P4.objective: After this module every agent in the team will meet P4 (Accurate product explanation) on every call.
P4.why: Saying 'all hospitals are cashless' sets up a failed claim experience and a complaint.
P4.rule: P4 Accurate product explanation (15 points, major). MET: Plan name, sum insured or IDV and main features stated correctly.

P10.title: Closing with summary and free-look: team TL-4
P10.objective: After this module every agent in the team will meet P10 (Closing and next steps) on every call.
P10.why: Without a summary and the free-look mention, customers are surprised by their policy and cancel.
P10.rule: P10 Closing and next steps (15 points, minor). MET: Summarises plan, premium, what happens next and when; after a sale, says documents will arrive and mentions the free-look period.

excerpts.reason: Abrupt close with no summary or next step

P9.title: Listening without interrupting: team TL-4
P9.objective: After this module every agent in the team will meet P9 (Listening and courtesy) on every call.
P9.why: Talking over customers drives rude-behaviour complaints and lost sales.
P9.rule: P9 Listening and courtesy (20 points, minor). MET: Lets the customer finish, answers patiently, respectful language.
